name: How much does it cost to upgrade bathroom lighting and electrical outlets?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to upgrade bathroom lighting and electrical outlets?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost for bathroom lighting and electrical upgrades varies significantly based on the scope of work. Factors influencing the price include the number of new fixtures, the need for new wiring runs, electrical panel upgrades, and the complexity of integrating smart home systems. Simple outlet replacements are less costly than a complete rewire with new recessed lighting and dedicated circuits. To provide an accurate estimate for clients in Berkeley or Oakland, Frasheski Construction performs a detailed on-site assessment to understand specific requirements and any necessary structural modifications.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on scope, from simple outlet replacements to complete rewires with new fixtures and panel upgrades. An on-site assessment is needed for an accurate estimate.
